evidence_slice: HM Revenue & Customs' GOV.UK page 'Maps of East Midlands Investment Zone tax sites' lists Hartington as one of three East Midlands Investment Zone tax sites, states the sites are designated and recognised in law, and says the designation takes effect from 26 February 2025. The Designation of Special Tax Sites (East Midlands Investment Zone) Regulations 2025 (SI 2025/111) designates the areas shown on the map entitled 'Hartington Tax Site' dated 2 October 2024 as a special area for Finance Act 2021 purposes. The official Hartington map states a site area of 24.61 hectares.
